what_to_include: Treatment, outcome, target population, and estimand are written plainly.
Every model feature is confirmed to be pre-treatment for the target decision.
The report explains why included controls are plausible confounders and what may be missing.
Propensity distributions, bucket counts, or support filters are shown.
Treatment and outcome nuisance diagnostics are reported.
Results are checked across at least one reasonable alternative estimator or specification.
CATE claims are summarized by calibrated groups or segments, not only individual scores.
Treatment cost, threshold rule, treatment rate, and net value are reported.
Intervals or bootstrap checks are included for key estimates or policy values.
Unobserved confounding, overlap gaps, measurement limits, and validation needs are stated.
